"""Import the isolated Oguri PMX copy with a pinned MMD Tools reader, without game edits."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import bpy
import addon_utils

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
repo=ROOT/'modding/tools/blender_mmd_tools'
revision=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
assert revision=='f1d8a98db5e185cfa73c9b8a8a67fa42d9eb4b14'
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo))
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'modding/tools/mmd-python-deps'))
addon_utils.enable('mmd_tools',default_set=True)
assert 'mmd_tools' in bpy.context.preferences.addons
sources=list((ROOT/'modding/model-sources/00').rglob('*.pmx'));assert len(sources)==1
source=sources[0];before=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT');bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
bpy.ops.mmd_tools.import_model(filepath=str(source),scale=.1,types={'MESH','ARMATURE','MORPHS','DISPLAY'},clean_model=False,save_log=False)
meshes=[o for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type=='MESH'];rigs=[o for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type=='ARMATURE']
assert meshes and len(rigs)==1 and len(rigs[0].data.bones)>100
assert sum(len(o.data.vertices) for o in meshes)>30000
missing=[i.filepath for i in bpy.data.images if i.source=='FILE' and i.filepath and not Path(bpy.path.abspath(i.filepath)).is_file()]
assert not missing,missing
assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==before
out=ROOT/'modding/blender-review/oguri';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
bpy.ops.file.pack_all();bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(out/'oguri-source.blend'))
report={'source_sha256':before,'reader_commit':revision,'mesh_objects':len(meshes),'vertices':sum(len(o.data.vertices) for o in meshes),'triangles':sum(sum(len(p.vertices)-2 for p in o.data.polygons) for o in meshes),'bones':len(rigs[0].data.bones),'materials':len(bpy.data.materials),'images':len(bpy.data.images),'missing_textures':missing,'scope':'Source import only, no runtime export or game installation'}
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report))

"""Render the imported source scene for visual review, without changing the source rig."""
from pathlib import Path
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
folder=ROOT/'modding/blender-review/oguri'
bpy.ops.wm.open_mainfile(filepath=str(folder/'oguri-source.blend'))
points=[o.matrix_world@Vector(point) for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type=='MESH' for point in o.bound_box]
assert points
low=Vector(tuple(min(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)));high=Vector(tuple(max(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)))
center=(low+high)*.5;height=high.z-low.z;assert height>0
scene=bpy.context.scene;scene.render.engine='CYCLES';scene.cycles.device='CPU';scene.cycles.samples=8
scene.world.color=(.3,.3,.3)
for name,direction,power in [('Review key',(2,-3,3),500),('Review fill',(-2,2,2),300)]:
    lamp=bpy.data.lights.new(name,'AREA');lamp.energy=power;lamp.shape='DISK';lamp.size=height*2
    obj=bpy.data.objects.new(name,lamp);scene.collection.objects.link(obj);obj.location=center+Vector(direction)*height
    obj.rotation_euler=(center-obj.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler()
camera=bpy.data.cameras.new('Review camera');obj=bpy.data.objects.new('Review camera',camera);scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
obj.location=center+Vector((2,-4,1))*height;obj.rotation_euler=(center-obj.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler()
camera.type='ORTHO';camera.ortho_scale=max(height*1.25,(high.x-low.x)*1.5);scene.camera=obj
scene.render.resolution_x=480;scene.render.resolution_y=640;scene.render.resolution_percentage=100
scene.render.filepath=str(folder/'oguri-review.png');bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)

"""Build an independent Blender review scene from the verified runtime rest mesh."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import math
import struct
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
source=ROOT/'modding/runtime/kitasan.umab';data=source.read_bytes()
magic,version,vertices,indices,bones,idle,run,reserved=struct.unpack_from('<4s7I',data)
assert magic==b'UMAB' and version==2 and vertices==14512 and indices%3==0 and bones==282 and not reserved
rows=[struct.unpack_from('<6f4B2f',data,32+i*36) for i in range(vertices)]
assert all(math.isfinite(value) for row in rows for value in row)
start=32+vertices*60+bones*16;faces=struct.unpack_from(f'<{indices}H',data,start)
assert max(faces)<vertices
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT');bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new('Runtime rest mesh');mesh.from_pydata([r[:3] for r in rows],[],[faces[i:i+3] for i in range(0,indices,3)]);mesh.update()
assert not mesh.validate() and len(mesh.vertices)==vertices and len(mesh.polygons)==indices//3
obj=bpy.data.objects.new('Kitasan — runtime source review',mesh);bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)
uv=mesh.uv_layers.new(name='Runtime UV')
for loop in mesh.loops:uv.data[loop.index].uv=(rows[loop.vertex_index][-2],1-rows[loop.vertex_index][-1])
for polygon in mesh.polygons:polygon.use_smooth=True
mesh.normals_split_custom_set_from_vertices([r[3:6] for r in rows])
material=bpy.data.materials.new('Original atlas review');material.use_nodes=True
shader=material.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF');shader.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=.8
texture=material.node_tree.nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexImage');texture.image=bpy.data.images.load(str(ROOT/'modding/character-source/atlas.png'));texture.image.pack()
material.node_tree.links.new(texture.outputs['Color'],shader.inputs['Base Color']);material.node_tree.links.new(texture.outputs['Alpha'],shader.inputs['Alpha']);obj.data.materials.append(material)
scene=bpy.context.scene;scene.render.engine='CYCLES';scene.cycles.device='CPU';scene.cycles.samples=8
scene.world.color=(.3,.3,.3)
for name,location,power,size in [('Key',(3,-4,5),500,4),('Fill',(-2,3,3),300,3)]:
    light=bpy.data.lights.new(name,'AREA');light.energy=power;light.shape='DISK';light.size=size
    actor=bpy.data.objects.new(name,light);scene.collection.objects.link(actor);actor.location=location;actor.rotation_euler=(Vector((0,0,1))-actor.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler()
camera=bpy.data.cameras.new('Review camera');actor=bpy.data.objects.new('Review camera',camera);scene.collection.objects.link(actor);actor.location=(4,-6,2.7);actor.rotation_euler=(Vector((0,0,1))-actor.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler();camera.type='ORTHO';camera.ortho_scale=2.5;scene.camera=actor
scene.render.resolution_x=480;scene.render.resolution_y=640;scene.render.resolution_percentage=100
out=ROOT/'modding/blender-review';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
scene.render.filepath=str(out/'kitasan-rest.png');bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(out/'kitasan-rest.blend'));bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'runtime_sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'vertices':vertices,'triangles':indices//3,'scope':'Rest-mesh review only; no animation, rig or game installation changed','blender_version':bpy.app.version_string},indent=2)+'\n')
